method.name: Lake Tefé and the Middle Solimões

reviewed.note: Water from the bay east of Vista Alegre towards Canaman at least 300 m wide on Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 of 30-31 Aug; the reference's narrowing under 60 m at -3.41711, -64.80745 is mixed shore pixels.

Link clear on Sentinel-1 (10 m) of 13 Oct and on Sentinel-2 of 11 Oct; the point is a small bright patch next to the water. The scene of 13 Oct read the wind-roughened water around it as land; with the darkest of the two scenes the route is kept.
Channel clear and over 100 m wide on Sentinel-1 (10 m). On Sentinel-2 a cloud cuts the channel right at that point, but it is also over 100 m wide.
Channel clear and over 100 m wide on Sentinel-1 (10 m). On Sentinel-2 a cloud cuts the channel right at that point, but it is also over 100 m wide.
Sentinel-2 cloudy on 11 Oct around Santa Luzia do Catuiri. Near Vila Siao, on 4 Nov, Sentinel-2 clouds cut the link to Lake Tefe while Sentinel-1 (10 m) shows it clearly, over 100 m wide.

The point between Sao Jose and Parauari lies by the Solimoes, over 1 km wide at its narrowest. Across from Assuncao (Jaquiri) the side channel is about 40 m at its narrowest on Sentinel-1 (10 m) and Sentinel-2, but Jaquiri is less than 1 km from the Solimoes and should count as connected.
The point is inside Lake Tefe, far from the shore: open water (Sentinel-1 reads it about -15.5 dB on 4 Nov, wind).
